zh-TW.headline: REA 副作用逐項驗證與社群外掛 rea-jev 同日出現
zh-TW.summary: 這天只有兩個項目，熱度都是 0，都偏向「在 REA 外層加一層檢查」。人工整理的驗證顯示，16 項功能宣告中改寫目標、需 root、改權限皆為 0，但有 10 項會啟動程序，不能無條件放行，Evidence 的 SHA-256 也經 sha256sum 驗證完全一致。社群外掛 rea-jev 則把 REA 的 MCP server 與 Jev 判斷模型結合，做工具路由、呼叫前檢查與證據追蹤，不過檢查只是建議性質，不是安全邊界。資料不足以與前幾天做比較，重點在於調查結果的可信度正被獨立檢驗。

en.headline: REA side-effect audit and the rea-jev plugin land on the same day
en.summary: Only two items appeared, both with zero heat, and both add a checking layer around REA. A hand-curated audit found that across 16 feature declarations, none rewrite targets, require root or change permissions, but 10 launch processes and so cannot be allowed unconditionally; the Evidence SHA-256 hashes also matched exactly under sha256sum. The community plugin rea-jev combines REA's MCP server with the Jev judgment model to add tool routing, pre-call checks and evidence tracking, though its checks are advisory rather than a security boundary. There is not enough data to compare with previous days, but the theme is clear: the trustworthiness of investigation results is being independently verified.

zh-CN.headline: REA 副作用逐项验证与社区插件 rea-jev 同日出现
zh-CN.summary: 这天只有两个项目，热度都是 0，都偏向“在 REA 外层加一层检查”。人工整理的验证显示，16 项功能声明中改写目标、需 root、改权限皆为 0，但有 10 项会启动进程，不能无条件放行，Evidence 的 SHA-256 也经 sha256sum 验证完全一致。社区插件 rea-jev 则把 REA 的 MCP server 与 Jev 判断模型结合，做工具路由、调用前检查与证据追踪，不过检查只是建议性质，不是安全边界。数据不足以与前几天做比较，重点在于调查结果的可信度正被独立检验。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數倍增至 1 萬以上，Mac 實測文章同日出現
zh-TW.summary: 當天 REA GitHub 星數達 10746，比前一個紀錄 5336 多出 5410，增幅超過一倍。當天只有一個項目：一篇人工整理的案例，在 REA 登上 Trending 第一的同一天於 Mac 上實測，整理出安裝與執行會遇到的 4 個問題，並說明 Decompile → Understand → Recreate 的調查流程。這顯示工具爆紅後，社群很快開始補上平台相容性與上手方法，不過當天資料量少、評分也只有 2/5，只能視為早期訊號。

en.headline: REA stars pass 10,000 as a hands-on Mac pitfalls write-up appears the same day
en.summary: REA's GitHub star count reached 10,746, up 5,410 from the previous record of 5,336, more than doubling. The day's only item is a hand-curated case study: written the day REA hit #1 on Trending, it tests REA on a Mac, lists 4 pitfalls in installation and running, and explains the Decompile → Understand → Recreate investigation flow. It suggests the community quickly starts filling in platform compatibility and onboarding once a tool goes viral, but with a single item rated 2/5 it is only an early signal.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数翻倍至 1 万以上，Mac 实测文章同日出现
zh-CN.summary: 当天 REA GitHub 星数达 10746，比之前的记录 5336 多出 5410，增幅超过一倍。当天只有一个条目：一篇人工整理的案例，在 REA 登上 Trending 第一的同一天于 Mac 上实测，整理出安装与运行会遇到的 4 个问题，并说明 Decompile → Understand → Recreate 的调查流程。这表明工具爆红后，社区很快开始补上平台兼容性与上手方法，不过当天数据量少、评分也只有 2/5，只能视为早期信号。

zh-TW.headline: REA 用免費工具完成逐位元組驗證，驗證成為焦點
zh-TW.summary: 這天最值得看的是兩則重視驗證的案例：一位作者依 REA 的發現重寫筆記匯出的 CSV 格式器，再用第二個解析器逐位元組比對，全數通過且只用免費軟體；另一則在 GitHub Actions 上以全合成檔案跑通 Ghidra、JADX、Binwalk/Unblob 三條流程，並明說這不代表對真實程式的驗證。另有 GunZRs 把 GunZ 移植到 Rust，素材取自玩家自己的 Steam 安裝。整體重心從「能不能逆向」轉向「怎麼證明結果是對的」，同時舊遊戲移植也持續出現。

en.headline: REA work verified byte-for-byte with free tools; verification takes center stage
en.summary: The standout items are two verification-minded cases. One author rebuilt a notes-export CSV formatter from REA's findings and checked it byte-for-byte against a second parser, with everything passing using only free software. Another ran REA's Ghidra, JADX and Binwalk/Unblob workflows on fully synthetic files in GitHub Actions, and states plainly that this does not validate real programs or firmware. GunZRs, a Rust port of GunZ that loads assets from the player's own Steam install, also appeared. The emphasis is shifting from whether REA can reverse something to how to prove the result is right, while legacy game ports keep showing up.

zh-CN.headline: REA 用免费工具完成逐字节验证，验证成为焦点
zh-CN.summary: 这天最值得看的是两则重视验证的案例：一位作者依 REA 的发现重写笔记导出的 CSV 格式器，再用第二个解析器逐字节比对，全部通过且只用免费软件；另一则在 GitHub Actions 上以全合成文件跑通 Ghidra、JADX、Binwalk/Unblob 三条流程，并明说这不代表对真实程序的验证。另有 GunZRs 把 GunZ 移植到 Rust，素材取自玩家自己的 Steam 安装。整体重心从“能不能逆向”转向“怎么证明结果是对的”，同时旧游戏移植也持续出现。

zh-TW.headline: 兩個案例同講一件事：REA 的結論要附證據、可驗證
zh-TW.summary: 這天的重點是兩個人工整理的案例：一個用 REA 6.2.0 加 Ghidra 靜態審查 Ubuntu 的 netcat，每個結論都附原始證據檔，結果與上游一致、沒有植入跡象；另一個拿自寫的 Electron App 當標準答案，發現 IPC、API 與視窗設定的重建數值完全正確，但「為什麼是隱藏功能」仍要人自己讀 Evidence。TraceBrief 則進一步用確定性腳本檢查報告引用的證據是否存在，不成立就拒絕產出。這顯示社群關注的重點正從「能不能分析」轉向「結論能不能驗證」。

en.headline: Two cases show REA conclusions need evidence you can verify
en.summary: Two hand-curated cases lead the day. One statically audits Ubuntu's netcat with REA 6.2.0 and Ghidra, attaching raw evidence files to every conclusion; it found the binary consistent with upstream and no sign of implanted code. The other tests REA against a self-written Electron app with known answers: IPC wiring, public APIs and window settings were reconstructed exactly, but the explanation of why a feature is hidden still has to be pieced together from the Evidence. TraceBrief goes a step further, using a deterministic script to check that every cited Evidence item exists and refusing to produce a report if one does not. The community's focus is shifting from whether REA can analyze to whether its conclusions can be verified.

zh-CN.headline: 两个案例共同说明：REA 的结论要附证据、可验证
zh-CN.summary: 这天的重点是两个人工整理的案例：一个用 REA 6.2.0 加 Ghidra 静态审查 Ubuntu 的 netcat，每个结论都附原始证据文件，结果与上游一致、没有植入迹象；另一个拿自写的 Electron App 当标准答案，发现 IPC、API 与窗口设置的重建数值完全正确，但“为什么是隐藏功能”仍要人自己读 Evidence。TraceBrief 则进一步用确定性脚本检查报告引用的证据是否存在，不成立就拒绝产出。这说明社区关注的重点正从“能不能分析”转向“结论能不能验证”。

zh-TW.headline: 東方遊戲逐函式重建登頂,社群實作與工具並進
zh-TW.summary: 這天 REA 星數升至 58461,比前一個紀錄 10746 多出 47715,關注度明顯暴增。排名第一的是東方 Project 三部作的逐函式重建:用 Agent 分析原始執行檔、還原 C++ 並與原二進位比對,TH08 已有 Linux 與瀏覽器可玩版本。另有 DOS 遊戲 Larax & Zaco 的反編譯,且明確聲明不是可玩遊戲、也非位元級一致;以及對上線中的 Next.js + Stripe 系統做外洩檢查。其餘多是 MCP 精簡橋接、DeepSeek 外掛與教學專案,顯示生態系持續擴張;不少高熱度貼文只有心得、沒有證據,值得保留判斷。

en.headline: Touhou function-by-function rebuild tops the day as tools and tutorials grow
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 58,461 on this day, up 47,715 from the previous record of 10,746. The top item is a function-by-function rebuild of three Touhou Project games, using agents to analyze the original executables, recover C++ and compare against the original binaries; TH08 is already playable on Linux and in the browser. Other evidence-backed work includes a decompilation of the DOS game Larax & Zaco, which explicitly says it is neither playable nor bit-exact, and an external leak check of a live Next.js + Stripe system. Much of the rest is ecosystem building, such as a thin MCP bridge cutting 139 tools to 21, DeepSeek Harness plugins and tutorials, while several high-heat posts offer only impressions without evidence.

zh-CN.headline: 东方游戏逐函数重建登顶,社区实践与工具并进
zh-CN.summary: 这天 REA 星数升至 58461,比之前的纪录 10746 多出 47715,关注度明显暴增。排名第一的是东方 Project 三部作的逐函数重建:用 Agent 分析原始可执行文件、还原 C++ 并与原二进制比对,TH08 已有 Linux 与浏览器可玩版本。另有 DOS 游戏 Larax & Zaco 的反编译,并明确声明不是可玩游戏、也非位级一致;以及对线上 Next.js + Stripe 系统做的泄露检查。其余多是 MCP 精简桥接、DeepSeek 插件与教学项目,显示生态持续扩张;不少高热度帖子只有心得、没有证据,值得保留判断。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數衝破 7.6 萬，逆向案例從遊戲延伸到韌體與核心
zh-TW.summary: 2026-10-11 的 REA GitHub 星數達 76998，比前一個紀錄 58461 增加 18537。當天排名最前的幾則都是有細節的案例：Obsidian 快速切換器排序演算法約 4 分鐘重建並逐筆比對、ZWO ASIAIR 韌體純靜態分析發現 4700 埠為明文 JSON-RPC、Untangle 重建在 54 項主張中對 52 項。同時也出現把 Windows 版魔獸世界、DOS 遊戲、arm64 核心納入的案例，顯示 REA 的使用範圍持續擴大，而且愈來愈多作者用對照原版或標示「已證實／推論／未知」的方式驗證結論。

en.headline: REA passes 76,998 stars as cases spread from games to firmware and kernels
en.summary: On 2026-10-11 REA's GitHub stars reached 76,998, up 18,537 from the previous record of 58,461. The top items were detailed cases: Obsidian's quick switcher ranking rebuilt in about 4 minutes and compared entry by entry, ZWO ASIAIR firmware analyzed purely statically with a plaintext JSON-RPC control port on 4700, and an Untangle rebuild where 52 of 54 checkable claims held up. Targets also ranged from a World of Warcraft client and a DOS game to an arm64 kernel, and more authors validated their conclusions by comparing against the original or labeling findings as confirmed, inferred or unknown.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数突破 7.6 万，逆向案例从游戏延伸到固件与内核
zh-CN.summary: 2026-10-11 的 REA GitHub 星数达 76998，比前一个纪录 58461 增加 18537。当天排名最前的几则都是有细节的案例：Obsidian 快速切换器排序算法约 4 分钟重建并逐笔比对、ZWO ASIAIR 固件纯静态分析发现 4700 端口为明文 JSON-RPC、Untangle 重建在 54 项主张中对 52 项。同时也出现把 Windows 版魔兽世界、DOS 游戏、arm64 内核纳入的案例，显示 REA 的使用范围持续扩大，而且越来越多作者用对照原版或标示「已证实／推论／未知」的方式验证结论。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數暴增逾五萬,逆向工程案例從遊戲擴及應用與硬體
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數來到 129748,比前一個紀錄 76998 多了 52750。當天 105 個項目中,排名最前的多是有實際成果的案例:東方 Project 逐函式重建、Obsidian 快速切換器排序演算法還原、Claude Slides 編輯器近乎完整復刻,以及僅憑 REA 重建 Untangle 並由獨立 agent 對照原始碼評分(54 項主張中 52 項正確)。題材已不限於老遊戲,還涵蓋 ZWO ASIAIR 韌體、智慧馬桶藍牙協定與 Steam 遊戲;同時也出現「純 Claude 先完成、結果相近」的對照,提醒 REA 的優勢仍有爭議。

en.headline: REA stars jump by over 50,000 as reverse-engineering cases spread beyond games
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 129,748, up 52,750 from the previous record of 76,998. Of the 105 items that day, the top ones are cases with concrete results: function-by-function Touhou rebuilds, a recovered Obsidian quick-switcher ranking algorithm, a near-complete clone of the Claude Slides editor, and an Untangle rebuild made only with REA and graded against the source by an independent agent (52 of 54 checkable claims correct). Topics now go beyond old games to ZWO ASIAIR firmware, a smart toilet's Bluetooth protocol and a Steam game. One comparison found plain Claude finished first with a similar result, so REA's edge is still debated.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数暴增逾五万,逆向工程案例从游戏扩及应用与硬件
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 129748,比之前的纪录 76998 多了 52750。当天 105 个项目中,排名靠前的多是有实际成果的案例:东方 Project 逐函数重建、Obsidian 快速切换器排序算法还原、Claude Slides 编辑器近乎完整复刻,以及仅凭 REA 重建 Untangle 并由独立 agent 对照源码评分(54 项主张中 52 项正确)。题材已不限于老游戏,还涵盖 ZWO ASIAIR 固件、智能马桶蓝牙协议与 Steam 游戏;同时也出现“纯 Claude 先完成、结果相近”的对照,提醒 REA 的优势仍有争议。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 16.8 萬,一天內多款商用軟體被逆向重建
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數達 168009,比前一個紀錄 129748 增加 38261。當天 52 個項目中,排名靠前的多是實作案例:有人拆解 Screen Studio、CapCut、剪映、Microsoft Word,也有人還原 Chrome 恐龍遊戲、Vanguard 伺服器登入與 DOOM 亂數程式的被改動處。其中不少只有作者自述,沒附程式碼或測試;較有驗證的是十個發行元件的逐筆比對研究(686 項通過測試)、DOOM 差異還原(兩版皆通過全部測試),以及 Word 重建附的功能對照表(作者坦承仍有粗糙處)。這顯示客戶端軟體的功能被快速複製,而如何驗證成果,比複製本身更關鍵。

en.headline: REA passes 168k stars as many commercial apps get reverse-engineered in a day
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 168,009, up 38,261 from the previous record of 129,748. Most of the top items among the day's 52 were hands-on cases: people took apart Screen Studio, CapCut, Jianying and Microsoft Word, and others recovered the Chrome dino game, a Vanguard server login and the tampered spot in DOOM's random-number code. Many are the author's own account with no code or tests. The better-verified ones are the ten-component differential study (686 passing tests), the DOOM diff recovery (both versions pass all tests) and the Word rebuild with a feature comparison table (the author admits it is still rough). Client-side features are being cloned fast, and checking the results matters more than the cloning itself.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 16.8 万,一天内多款商用软件被逆向重建
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 168009,比之前的纪录 129748 增加 38261。当天 52 个项目中,排名靠前的多是实操案例:有人拆解 Screen Studio、CapCut、剪映、Microsoft Word,也有人还原 Chrome 恐龙游戏、Vanguard 服务器登录和 DOOM 随机数程序被改动的地方。其中不少只有作者自述,没附代码或测试;较有验证的是十个发行组件的逐项对比研究(686 项通过测试)、DOOM 差异还原(两个版本都通过全部测试),以及 Word 重建附的功能对照表(作者坦承仍有粗糙之处)。这说明客户端软件的功能正被快速复制,而如何验证成果,比复制本身更关键。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 21 萬,逆向複刻從大型軟體走向日常工具
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數達 214553,比前一個紀錄 168009 多了 46544。當天排名最前面的案例幾乎都是拿 REA 逆向現成軟體再自行重做:Typeless 免登入替代品、Obsidian 圖譜物理、VS Code、WinDirStat,還有《異塵餘生:新維加斯》的物件保存機制。多個專案附上測試、規格或誠實列出差距,但也有案例沒有 repo 或證據,另有實測指出 REA 在 A/B 試驗中耗時最多 2.00 倍、費用最多 1.67 倍。這說明前端與桌面軟體的功能越來越容易被複刻,可信度的瓶頸則落在驗證與成本。

en.headline: REA passes 214K stars as reverse-engineered clones reach everyday tools
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 214,553, up 46,544 from the previous record of 168,009. Most of the top cases use REA to reverse-engineer existing software and rebuild it: a login-free Typeless alternative, Obsidian's graph physics, VS Code, WinDirStat, and the object-persistence rules of Fallout: New Vegas. Several projects ship tests, specs or an honest list of gaps, but others give no repo or evidence, and one A/B test found REA took up to 2.00x the time and up to 1.67x the API cost. Features are getting easier to clone, while verification and cost are the real limits.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 21 万,逆向复刻从大型软件走向日常工具
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达 214553,比前一个纪录 168009 多了 46544。当天排名靠前的案例几乎都是用 REA 逆向现成软件再自行重做:Typeless 免登录替代品、Obsidian 图谱物理、VS Code、WinDirStat,还有《辐射:新维加斯》的物件保存机制。多个项目附上测试、规格或如实列出差距,但也有案例没有 repo 或证据,另有实测指出 REA 在 A/B 试验中耗时最多 2.00 倍、费用最多 1.67 倍。这说明前端与桌面软件的功能越来越容易被复刻,可信度的瓶颈则落在验证与成本。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數暴增逾三萬三，DX-Ball 聲像還原成最紮實案例
zh-TW.summary: REA GitHub 星數從 214553 升到 248239，一天增加 33686。排名最前的是 DX-Ball 左右聲像公式還原：以 3,205 個輸入對照原始 x86 函式，並重現 63 個編譯位元組，官方案例集與指南也同日收錄。社群案例更廣，涵蓋 Claude Desktop 手感手冊、PLC 協定、小米電視 MiLink 與 HP OMEN 控制中心，但不少 X 貼文只有自述，沒附程式碼或測試。可驗證的案例與只憑自述的案例差距明顯，這是目前最值得留意的地方。

en.headline: REA stars jump over 33,000; DX-Ball pan recovery is the most rigorous case
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars rose from 214,553 to 248,239, a gain of 33,686 in one day. The top item recovers DX-Ball's stereo pan formula, checked against the original x86 function on 3,205 inputs and reproducing 63 compiled bytes. The official case collection and guide cover it too. Community work is broad, from a Claude Desktop feel manual to a PLC protocol, Xiaomi TV MiLink and an HP OMEN control center. Many X posts are self-reported with no code or tests, so the gap between verified and unverified cases is the thing to watch.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数暴增逾三万三，DX-Ball 声像还原成最扎实案例
zh-CN.summary: REA GitHub 星数从 214553 升到 248239，一天增加 33686。排名最前的是 DX-Ball 左右声像公式还原：以 3,205 个输入对照原始 x86 函数，并重现 63 个编译字节，官方案例集与指南也同日收录。社区案例更广，涵盖 Claude Desktop 手感手册、PLC 协议、小米电视 MiLink 与 HP OMEN 控制中心，但不少 X 帖子只有自述，没附代码或测试。可验证的案例与只凭自述的案例差距明显，这是目前最值得留意的地方。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 27.5 萬,實作與驗證型案例佔上風

en.headline: REA passes 275K stars as verified builds outrank hype
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 275,074, up 26,835 from the previous record. The top-ranked items are backed by verification: Touhou TH08 and TH095 rebuilt with function-by-function oracle comparison, a BLE cup protocol checked packet by packet on real hardware, and Ultima VI ported to a browser-playable Rust/wasm build. The hottest X posts are mostly self-reported with no repo or tests, and one project openly admits its anti-cracking goal was not met. Evidence-backed results stand out more than bare clone claims.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 27.5 万,实现与验证型案例占上风

en.headline: REA passes 290K stars as rebuilds shift toward provable fidelity
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars rose to 293,428, up 18,354 from the previous record. The top item is rea-engine, whose author claims 19,683 board states verified, pixel-render SHA-256 matches and Z3 proofs, plus a port of the rebuilt executable to macOS. Another post audited REA-rebuilt game functions and found tests that passed while a constant was wrong (original adds 32.0f, rebuild adds 1.0f). Most high-heat posts are still paid apps being cloned (Electron, Photoshop, an AE panel, Calendly), mostly self-reported; the cases with repos or evidence, and the audit showing tests can be fooled, put the question of how to prove a rebuild is correct front and center.

en.headline: REA passes 300K stars; reverse-engineering spreads from games to devices and sites
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 309,972, up 16,544 from the previous record of 293,428. The top case forked REA into rea-engine and rebuilt a Windows tic-tac-toe from its binary, matching the original on all 19,683 board states. Others include a function-by-function DX-Ball rebuild (3,205 tests, a 63-byte match after recompiling with the period compiler) and pixel-level verification of Golden Sun sprites. The strongest cases ship reproducible comparisons or tests, so the emphasis is shifting from "it works" to "it provably matches". There were also cases of controlling one's own devices (a Hitachi oven, Bluetooth earbuds, a Samsung TV), plus one post-mortem saying REA's 207 tools overloaded an agent's context.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 30 万,逆向案例从游戏扩及硬件与网站

en.headline: REA stars jump 15K in a day; reverse engineering extends to hardening
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 325,024, up 15,052 from the previous record. The top item reverse-engineers Linux WeChat into 32 MCP tools and 5 Skills, which the author says were verified on a real client. Another project turns a single browser recording into 44 RL environments. Notably, a hardening tool built to resist REA appeared; its author says endpoints and IPC that were recoverable from the original could not be recovered after hardening, so attack and defense are both taking shape. Many X posts about cloning apps (such as copying Flighty in 9 minutes) are self-reported, with no repo or comparison evidence.

en.headline: REA passes 338K stars; cases span TVs, cameras and games
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 338,787, up 13,763 from the previous record. The most eye-catching posts apply REA to people's own devices and old software: a Raycast rebuild on Omarchy, plus reverse engineering of Samsung Tizen and webOS TVs and an air-conditioner WiFi module. The better-evidenced items are three GitHub projects: a Rollcage data parser and track viewer, a static reverse of Sony A6000 firmware (54 milestones with tests), and an HTML5 rebuild of Cuphead's first boss (with bot tests and documented value sources). Most X cases, however, are author claims with no code or reproducible steps. Meanwhile integrations such as the PiCode extension, the DeepSeek Harness package and a spec-driven workflow that requires runtime evidence show that evidence-first practice is spreading.

The top-ranked cases use REA with Ghidra to rebuild the 1995 Space Cadet pinball and the 1997 game Dark Colony, both backed by tests or validation against original files. Reconstructions of modern apps (Doubao IME, Trello, Apple Calendar) and hardware cases (Echo Dot 2 firmware, B-hyve sprinklers into HomeKit) also appeared. Note that several X posts, such as Oblivion and Pokémon Brilliant Diamond, offer only the author's claims and videos with no public repo or tests, so they remain unverified.

en.headline: REA passes 359K stars as five tested rebuilds and a Keen port show verifiable output
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 359,255, up 9,472 from the previous record. The most notable items were five TypeScript rebuilds checked by oracle tests against the originals, and a Commander Keen 1 native and web port built with REA and Ghidra. en.headline: REA stars pass 367K as clean-room rebuilds and verification take focus
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 367,482, up 8,227 from the previous record of 359,255. The top-ranked items moved from simply showing off reverse engineering toward workflows backed by evidence. One author used REA with Codex to statically analyze Windows malware in an isolated Docker environment and cross-checked the decrypted output with an independent Python implementation. Another had four agents do a clean-room rebuild, with match rate rising from 64% to 100% across 18 cases. REA is also spreading to Windows, with a UIA native-UI provider, and to legacy software and game remakes such as Bonkheads and Paste. Many posts remain self-reported with no evidence, such as the air fryer and the Mac app license removal, so treat those with caution.

zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 367,482，比之前的纪录 359,255 增加 8,227。当天排名靠前的项目从单纯展示逆向，转向附带证据的流程：有人用 REA 搭配 Codex 在隔离的 Docker 环境静态分析恶意程序，并用独立的 Python 实现比对解密结果；也有人用 4 个代理做洁净室重建，18 个用例的相符率从 64% 修正到 100%。另一个变化是 REA 向 Windows 扩展，出现了 UIA 原生 UI provider，还有 Bonkheads、Paste 等旧软件与游戏的重制。社区动态中仍有不少只有作者自述、没有附证据的帖子，例如空气炸锅与 Mac 应用授权移除，读者宜保留判断。

en.headline: REA cloning wave: Claude desktop and Arc rebuilt as open source
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars rose to 373,967 (up 6,485 from the previous record). The hottest cases were open-claude-ui, which decompiled the Claude desktop app into an MIT-licensed React component library, and Radian Browser, an open-source Arc replacement built by observing Arc's behavior after it shut down. Hardware work also appeared, including Tesla CarPlay box firmware patching and a remote-controlled kettle, along with a Rust rewrite of REA itself. Together they show client-side features being cloned quickly, though most posts are self-reported with little test evidence.

en.headline: REA stars up 5,856; reverse-engineering cases span software, audio and appliances
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 379,823 today, up 5,856 from the previous record. The strongest cases are a clean-room Python rewrite of G*Power's one-way ANOVA engine (245/245 fields matched) and a macOS VST3/AU port of the Windows-only Clamp clipper plugin, with tooling to compare it against the original. Others, such as the guitar pedal editor, Hisense TV and LG air conditioner, are mostly self-reports without evidence. Ecosystem tools also kept appearing, including DeepSeek Harness bundles, a Nix package and a retro-CPU fork. REA's reach is widening, but verifiable results remain concentrated in a few projects that ship tests.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数增5856,逆向案例扩及软件、音频与家电
zh-CN.summary: 今天 REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 379823,比前一纪录多 5856。最有分量的案例是 G*Power 单因子 ANOVA 引擎的净室重写(245/245 字段吻合),以及把仅限 Windows 的 Clamp 削波器插件移植成 macOS VST3/AU 并附比对工具。其他如吉他效果器编辑器、海信电视、LG 空调等多为作者自述、缺少佐证。此外,DeepSeek Harness 集成、Nix 包与复古 CPU 派生版等生态工具也持续增加,显示 REA 的使用面在扩大,但可验证的成果仍集中在少数附测试的项目。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 38.5 萬,v6.8 上線,復刻案例遍及老遊戲與 App
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數升至 385751,比前一個紀錄增加 5928,作者同時宣布 v6.8,新增可讓 agent 建立環境來訓練本地模型的 REA environments。當天案例涵蓋把 CoCo 遊戲《Major Istar》以原生 Z80 移植到 MSX(在 openMSX 五種設定通關,207 個命令點逐位元組一致)、重寫 BreezySRPG95 客戶端、復刻 Bear 與 Tangerine 等 macOS App,以及公開 MoCut 剪口播工具。值得注意的是,實測回報指出在小型程式上 REA 只增加成本、準確度沒有提升,另有專門對抗 AI 逆向的防護工具出現,顯示驗證與成本正成為重點;不少項目仍只有作者自述,缺少測試佐證。

en.headline: REA passes 385K stars with v6.8 as clones span retro games and apps
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars rose to 385,751, up 5,928 from the previous record, and the author announced v6.8, which adds REA environments so agents can build environments to train local models. Cases that day included a native Z80 port of the CoCo game Major Istar to MSX (cleared in five openMSX configurations, with 207 command points matching byte for byte), a rewritten BreezySRPG95 client, clones of macOS apps Bear and Tangerine, and the MoCut voice-over editing tool. A hands-on test reported that on small programs REA adds cost without improving accuracy, and a protection tool aimed at defeating AI reverse engineering appeared, which points to verification and cost as the live concerns. Many entries are still author claims with no tests behind them.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 38.5 万,v6.8 上线,复刻案例遍及老游戏与 App
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数升至 385751,比前一个记录增加 5928,作者同时宣布 v6.8,新增可让 agent 创建环境来训练本地模型的 REA environments。当天案例涵盖把 CoCo 游戏《Major Istar》以原生 Z80 移植到 MSX(在 openMSX 五种设置通关,207 个命令点逐字节一致)、重写 BreezySRPG95 客户端、复刻 Bear 与 Tangerine 等 macOS App,以及公开 MoCut 剪口播工具。值得注意的是,实测反馈指出在小型程序上 REA 只增加成本、准确度没有提升,另有专门对抗 AI 逆向的防护工具出现,显示验证与成本正成为重点;不少条目仍只有作者自述,缺少测试佐证。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 39 萬,逆向案例從遊戲擴及無人機與燈泡
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數來到 392673,比前一個紀錄 385751 多了 6922。當天最紮實的案例是用 REA 逐位元組還原 DX-Ball 音效函數(3205 個測試全過、63 位元組一致)、逆向 Yeelight 燈泡 NVRAM 接上 Home Assistant,以及重建 JTrac 並發布 3.0.0。熱度最高的幾則(安防無人機、GTA 5 合併 Minecraft、反編譯整款遊戲)多半只有作者自述、沒有程式碼或實測,可信度落差明顯。另有作者用 REA 逆向 gh cli,結論是分析很強,但約 90% 以上之後仍要大量人工重建與驗證。

en.headline: REA passes 390k stars; reverse-engineering spans games, drones and light bulbs
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 392,673, up 6,922 from the previous record of 385,751. The best-evidenced cases were a byte-for-byte recovery of DX-Ball's sound function (3,205 tests passing, 63 bytes identical), a Yeelight bulb NVRAM reverse that brings discontinued bulbs into Home Assistant, and a rebuilt JTrac released as 3.0.0. The hottest posts (a home-security drone, merging GTA 5 with Minecraft, decompiling a whole game) are mostly self-reported with no code or tests, so the gap in credibility is wide. One author who reverse-engineered gh cli found REA strong at analysis, but the last stretch beyond roughly 90% still takes heavy manual rebuilding and testing.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 39 万,逆向案例从游戏扩及无人机与灯泡
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 392673,比之前的纪录 385751 多了 6922。当天最扎实的案例是用 REA 逐字节还原 DX-Ball 音效函数(3205 个测试全过、63 字节一致)、逆向 Yeelight 灯泡 NVRAM 接入 Home Assistant,以及重建 JTrac 并发布 3.0.0。热度最高的几条(安防无人机、GTA 5 合并 Minecraft、反编译整款游戏)大多只有作者自述、没有代码或实测,可信度落差明显。另有作者用 REA 逆向 gh cli,结论是分析很强,但 90% 以上之后仍需大量人工重建与验证。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 39.8 萬，從 App 逆向到重建驗證成主軸
zh-TW.summary: REA 星數升至 398205，比前一個紀錄多 5532。當天最有料的兩則 GitHub 案例都把逆向結果落成可驗證的重寫：一個分析 OpenCode Desktop 的 sidecar 啟動流程，並對照上游原始碼逐項驗證、寫出通過 8 項測試的函式庫；另一個用 REA 與 CDP 分析 QuillBot 前端，再乾淨室重做出 OpenQuill。另有生態整合類工具（離線客戶端引擎、Windows 引擎打包、Ghidra 工作區）持續出現，不過 X 上多數貼文只是自述、缺乏證據，可信度有限。

en.headline: REA passes 398K stars as reverse engineering turns into verified rebuilds
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars rose to 398,205, up 5,532 from the previous record. The two strongest GitHub cases both turn reverse-engineering findings into verifiable rewrites: one analyzes OpenCode Desktop's sidecar startup, checks it against upstream source and ships a library passing 8 tests; the other uses REA and CDP on QuillBot's frontend to build a clean-room OpenQuill. Ecosystem tooling (an offline client engine, Windows engine packaging, a Ghidra workspace) keeps appearing, while most X posts are self-reports without evidence, so their reliability is limited.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 39.8 万，从 App 逆向到重建验证成主轴
zh-CN.summary: REA 星数升至 398205，比之前的纪录多 5532。当天最有料的两则 GitHub 案例都把逆向结果落成可验证的重写：一个分析 OpenCode Desktop 的 sidecar 启动流程，并对照上游源码逐项验证、写出通过 8 项测试的库；另一个用 REA 与 CDP 分析 QuillBot 前端，再净室重做出 OpenQuill。另有生态集成类工具（离线客户端引擎、Windows 引擎打包、Ghidra 工作区）持续出现，不过 X 上多数帖子只是自述、缺乏证据，可信度有限。

zh-TW.headline: REA 星數破 40 萬，驗證與實測成為焦點
zh-TW.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星數來到 407729，比前一個紀錄 398205 多了 9524。當天最扎實的項目是附有證據的案例：用 REA 與 Ghidra 逆向 C3RB3R 勒索軟體並從記憶體還原金鑰解密檔案、重建 Cluely 桌面助理，以及一份獨立對照實驗，在 20 個程式上未偵測到 REA 帶來準確度優勢。許多 X 上的貼文只有作者自述，缺乏證據，顯示熱度與可驗證性之間仍有落差；同時也出現把 REA 的 207 個工具壓縮成 3 個入口的外掛，反映對成本與工具負擔的關注。

en.headline: REA passes 400K stars as verification takes center stage
en.summary: REA's GitHub stars reached 407,729, up 9,524 from the previous record of 398,205. The most substantial items were evidence-backed: reversing the C3RB3R ransomware with REA and Ghidra and recovering keys from memory to decrypt files, rebuilding the Cluely desktop assistant, and an independent controlled experiment that detected no accuracy advantage from REA across 20 programs. Many X posts were self-reported with no evidence, showing a gap between buzz and verifiability, while a plugin folding REA's 207 tools into 3 entry points reflects growing concern over cost and tool overhead.

zh-CN.headline: REA 星数破 40 万，验证与实测成为焦点
zh-CN.summary: REA 的 GitHub 星数达到 407729，比之前的纪录 398205 多了 9524。当天最扎实的项目是附有证据的案例：用 REA 与 Ghidra 逆向 C3RB3R 勒索软件并从内存还原密钥解密文件、重建 Cluely 桌面助理，以及一份独立对照实验，在 20 个程序上未检测到 REA 带来准确度优势。许多 X 上的帖子只有作者自述，缺乏证据，说明热度与可验证性之间仍有落差；同时也出现把 REA 的 207 个工具压缩成 3 个入口的插件，反映对成本与工具负担的关注。

zh-TW.headline: REA 從拆解走向重建：多個專案以逆向結果做出可用的新應用
zh-TW.summary: 今天排名靠前的項目多半不只是分析，而是把逆向結果變成新作品：Rustify 從去符號二進位重寫 Rust 並與原版比對，hexgrab 與 PlainMount 分別源自 PowerToys 取色器與 NTFSTool，xRAR 則以雜湊驗證取出 WinRAR 的圖示與介面資訊。MarkText 的案例中，作者打開檔案確認了呼叫鏈，GitTested 的評測則指出在小型程式上 REA 與一般 shell 工具的準確度相近、只增加成本，顯示驗證仍是關鍵。另有幾則作者自述（如 ToDesk 彈窗、路由器空密碼、28 款應用）缺乏證據，需謹慎看待。GitHub 星數增加 911，達 408640。

en.headline: REA moves from teardown to rebuild: projects turn reverse-engineering into working apps
en.summary: Most top items today go beyond analysis and turn findings into new work: Rustify rewrites stripped binaries in Rust and diffs them against the original, hexgrab and PlainMount grew out of the PowerToys color picker and NTFSTool, and xRAR extracted WinRAR icons and UI details with hash verification. In the MarkText case the author opened the named files to confirm the call chain, while GitTested's benchmark found REA matched a plain shell agent on small programs and only added cost, which keeps verification at the center. Several self-reported claims (ToDesk popup removal, an empty-password router, 28 apps in 19 days) come without evidence and should be treated cautiously. GitHub stars rose by 911 to 408,640.

zh-CN.headline: REA 从拆解走向重建：多个项目以逆向结果做出可用的新应用
zh-CN.summary: 今天排名靠前的项目多半不只是分析，而是把逆向结果变成新作品：Rustify 从去符号二进制重写 Rust 并与原版比对，hexgrab 与 PlainMount 分别源自 PowerToys 取色器与 NTFSTool，xRAR 则以哈希验证取出 WinRAR 的图标与界面信息。MarkText 的案例中，作者打开文件确认了调用链，GitTested 的评测则指出在小型程序上 REA 与普通 shell 工具的准确度相近、只增加成本，说明验证仍是关键。另有几条作者自述（如 ToDesk 弹窗、路由器空密码、28 款应用）缺乏证据，需谨慎看待。GitHub 星数增加 911，达到 408640。

signals.A: Client-side code is no longer a moat (features get cloned fast)
signals.B: Verification is the bottleneck (differential tests, evidence, honest grading)
signals.C: Legacy software preservation and migration (games first, then enterprise)
signals.D: Hardware interop and control of one's own devices (firmware, BLE, IoT)
signals.E: Model-platform limits (refusals, account bans, policy changes)
signals.F: Cost and efficiency (tokens, tool surface, local models)
signals.G: Ecosystem expansion (new architectures, formats, integrations, ports)

zh-TW.headline: REA 從展示轉向重建，驗證與實測成為本週主軸
zh-TW.summary: 週初（10/24）焦點是 Claude 桌面端、Arc 被開源復刻，顯示前端程式碼與功能容易被快速複製。10/25 起，討論轉向可驗證的成果，例如 G*Power 淨室重寫 245/245 欄位吻合，以及 Clamp 外掛移植附比對工具。10/26 至 10/27 案例從老遊戲（MSX 移植、DX-Ball 音效逐位元組一致）延伸到無人機與 Yeelight 燈泡等硬體。10/28 至 10/30 則多為把逆向結果落成可用的新應用（OpenQuill、Cluely 重建、Rustify），同時獨立實驗顯示在小型程式上 REA 未帶來準確度優勢、只增加成本。整週 GitHub 星數從 373967 增至 408640，但不少熱門貼文仍只是作者自述、缺乏證據。
zh-TW.watch: 後續可留意附測試、雜湊或逐位元組比對的重建專案，這類成果比單純展示更可信。也值得觀察成本與工具負擔的優化（如把 207 個工具壓成 3 個入口），以及 REA 在小型與大型程式上的實際效益差異。若要找機會，可從驗證工具、遺留軟體遷移與硬體互通切入。

en.headline: REA shifts from showcase to rebuilds, with verification as the week's theme
en.summary: The week opened (10/24) with open-source clones of the Claude desktop app and Arc, showing client-side code and features are cloned quickly. From 10/25 the talk moved to verifiable results, such as a clean-room G*Power rewrite matching 245/245 fields and a Clamp plugin port with comparison tooling. On 10/26–10/27 cases spread from old games (an MSX port, byte-identical DX-Ball audio) to hardware like drones and Yeelight bulbs. From 10/28 to 10/30 most items turned reverse-engineering results into usable new apps (OpenQuill, a Cluely rebuild, Rustify), while independent tests found REA gave no accuracy advantage on small programs and only added cost. GitHub stars rose from 373,967 to 408,640 over the week, yet many popular posts were still unsupported author claims.
en.watch: Watch for rebuild projects backed by tests, hashes or byte-level comparison, which are more credible than demos. Also follow cost and tool-surface reductions (such as collapsing 207 tools into 3 entry points) and how REA's benefit differs between small and large programs. For opportunities, look at verification tooling, legacy software migration and hardware interoperability.

zh-CN.headline: REA 从展示转向重建，验证与实测成为本周主轴
zh-CN.summary: 周初（10/24）焦点是 Claude 桌面端、Arc 被开源复刻，说明前端代码和功能很容易被快速复制。10/25 起，讨论转向可验证的成果，例如 G*Power 净室重写 245/245 字段吻合，以及 Clamp 插件移植并附比对工具。10/26 至 10/27 案例从老游戏（MSX 移植、DX-Ball 音效逐字节一致）延伸到无人机与 Yeelight 灯泡等硬件。10/28 至 10/30 多为把逆向结果落成可用的新应用（OpenQuill、Cluely 重建、Rustify），同时独立实验显示在小型程序上 REA 没有带来准确度优势、只增加成本。整周 GitHub 星数从 373967 增至 408640，但不少热门帖子仍只是作者自述、缺乏证据。
zh-CN.watch: 后续可留意附测试、哈希或逐字节比对的重建项目，这类成果比单纯展示更可信。也值得观察成本与工具负担的优化（如把 207 个工具压成 3 个入口），以及 REA 在小型与大型程序上的实际效益差异。若要找机会，可从验证工具、遗留软件迁移与硬件互通切入。
